item.title: [LOW] CVE-2026-16562: The WP Statistics WordPress plugin before 14.16.10 does not perform a capabilit...
item.description: The WP Statistics WordPress plugin before 14.16.10 does not perform a capability check on a set of dashboard analytics AJAX handlers, relying only on a nonce that every authenticated user holds, allowing users with Subscriber-level access and above to disclose the site's visitor analytics data.

item.title: [LOW] CVE-2026-16559: The YMC Filter WordPress plugin before 3.12.9 does not sanitize SVG files upload...
item.description: The YMC Filter WordPress plugin before 3.12.9 does not sanitize SVG files uploaded through one of its icon upload features and permits their upload by low-privileged users, allowing users with the Author role and above to upload a file containing JavaScript that executes in the site's origin when the file is viewed.

item.title: [LOW] CVE-2026-16558: The YMC Filter WordPress plugin before 3.12.8 does not sanitize and escape a lay...
item.description: The YMC Filter WordPress plugin before 3.12.8 does not sanitize and escape a layout builder setting before outputting it on a public endpoint, and does not verify object ownership when the setting is saved, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to store JavaScript that executes in the browser of any visitor viewing an affected filter.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-16535: The Link Library WordPress plugin before 7.9.4 does not sanitise and escape a pa...
item.description: The Link Library WordPress plugin before 7.9.4 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before reflecting it back in a response, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform Reflected Cross-Site Scripting attacks against users who can be tricked into performing an action.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-16282: The Appointment Hour Booking WordPress plugin before 1.5.88 does not validate a...
item.description: The Appointment Hour Booking WordPress plugin before 1.5.88 does not validate a client-supplied booking price against the server-side configured service price, allowing unauthenticated users to submit an arbitrary final price (including zero or negative) that is stored as the authoritative booking price, corrupting booking and payment records.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-16269: The Newsletters WordPress plugin before 4.16 does not strictly compare its API a...
item.description: The Newsletters WordPress plugin before 4.16 does not strictly compare its API authentication key, allowing unauthenticated attackers to bypass the API authentication via type juggling and perform privileged actions such as modifying subscriber records and sending emails, when the optional API has been enabled.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-16267: The Newsletters WordPress plugin before 4.16 does not restrict the classes allow...
item.description: The Newsletters WordPress plugin before 4.16 does not restrict the classes allowed when unserialising a value taken from a public form submission, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP objects.
